8_flaky_drag.reproduced: idle 10/10 pass; with four CPU busy-loops 4/10 fail (data/flaky-drag-repeat10-*.log)
8_flaky_drag.cause: the wheel commits the option (aria-checked, onPreview) only in settle(), when the snap spring has come to rest, and the spring's step() clamps dt to 1/30 s, so it runs on frames, not on time. With the wheel open the room page draws 16.9 frames/s idle and 11.5 under load (SwiftShader), so the snap that takes ~1 s at 30 fps takes 3-5 s; the spec waits 5 s after mouse.up for the checked option to change. Instrumented: aria-checked turned to option 3 at 3.2-5.1 s after pointerup under load (data/diag-drag-loaded-fast.json), with every pointer event received and the drag captured
8_flaky_drag.fix: commit the target at release (physics.release() already picks it): setIndex and onPreview then, animate after; integrate the spring by real time (fixed sub-steps over the real dt, no 1/30 clamp). Then the spec's 5 s holds on a slow machine, and a slow phone does not show the new option seconds late
